counts.note: A column is kept only if h_edge>=8 m, L_B>=8 m, the 2·L_B profile fits in the image, and no other footprint and no undiluted clutter (nDSM>3 m outside footprints) lies between 1 m and 1.3·L_B in front of the near wall.

definitions.L_B: g - sqrt(g^2 - 2 H h + h^2), h = h_edge at the near wall
definitions.L_meas: farthest offset of the 9 px mean of linear power, max of 3 columns around the brightest within 3 m, >= 2x background on [1.6, 2] L_B, gaps <= 8 m. 0 if the threshold is never met.
definitions.half_front: x where the mean linear ratio falls to half its mean over x in [0, 0.3]
definitions.half_back: x where the mean linear ratio, divided by its [1.6, 2] level, crosses 0.5 upward
